column3: The Hebrew names commanders of thousands before commanders of hundreds; BSB reverses their order.
The Hebrew names David again and expresses each command through the leader’s hand; BSB uses “He” and “under”.
The Hebrew repeats not setting the heart toward them; BSB uses “pay no attention” and “not care”.
The Hebrew describes what is good “in your eyes” and names the king again at his standing; BSB uses “seems best” and “he”.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew calls the marching group “the people”; BSB specifies “David’s army”.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew repeats eating for the forest and sword; BSB leaves the second devouring verb implicit.
The Hebrew locates him “between heaven and earth”; BSB has “in midair”.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew names a single belt without specifying “warrior’s”.
The Hebrew says the king commanded “in our ears”; BSB says “we heard”.
The Hebrew describes doing falsehood against his own soul and Joab standing apart; BSB has jeopardizing his life and being abandoned.
The Hebrew repeats “heart” for Absalom and the tree; BSB names only Absalom’s heart.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew repeats “the people” for the returning group and those restrained; BSB has “the troops” and then “them”.
The Hebrew says each fled to his “tents”, plural; BSB has “home”.
The Hebrew calls the pillar “Absalom’s hand”; BSB has “Absalom’s Monument”.
The Hebrew says the LORD judged his cause from the hand of his enemies; BSB expresses this as avenging him.
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew leaves the reply speakers unnamed; BSB supplies both a pronoun and Joab.
The Hebrew explicitly says the watchman raised his eyes; BSB has “looked out”.
The Hebrew locates good news “in his mouth”; BSB has “he bears good news”.
The Hebrew repeats the watchman as caller; BSB uses “he”.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew greeting is “Peace”; BSB has “All is well”. The raised hand is singular, where BSB uses plural “hands”.
Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew explicitly says he stepped aside and stood; BSB leaves the final standing implicit.
